name: Apple Assistive Access
description: Built-in iPhone and iPad accessibility mode that can simplify the interface with larger controls, focused app experiences, visual layouts and selected communication options.
intended_use: Inspect whether a simplified Apple-device interface or visual alternatives to text might reduce device complexity for a particular person.
audience_or_context: People using supported iPhone or iPad devices, especially people with cognitive accessibility needs and trusted supporters helping with setup.
limitations: Requires compatible Apple hardware and current operating-system support; features vary by region, language and OS version.
A simpler interface can improve fit for some tasks but may remove functions someone wants or needs.
cost_or_access_notes: Built into supported Apple operating systems; the device itself is a paid commercial product.
conflicts_of_interest: Apple develops and sells the hardware and promotes its accessibility features; ND Oracle does not treat product marketing as independent evidence of benefit.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
